provenance.construction: Complete recorded TV/engine objects, split only at LF for readable JSON. Joining with LF restores the archived bytes, including BOM, CRLF and final-newline presence. SHA-256 values and recorded NET metrics come from the manifest.
provenance.profile_basis: The archived strategy objects contain no trail_price, trail_points or trail_offset parameter. Their only analyzer dependency is the strict profile, supplied through inputs.json; strategy source is omitted and its manifest SHA-256 retained.
